Applications are invited for One Guest faculty (Assistant Professor) in the Centre for Systems
Biology && Bioinformatics, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be filled in through Walk-in-interview,
purely on temporary basis, for the academic session 2024-25.
Essential Qualification for the post of Assistant Professor
Desirable
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Good academic record as define by the concerned University with at least 55% of the
marks (50% in case of SC/ST/Physically & Visually handicapped) or an equivalent grade
in a point wherever grading system is followed at Master's degree level i.e. Masters in
Computer Science/Information Technology and related area from an Indian University,
or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) Conducted by the UGC, CSIR.
The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or
equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Prof. Veena Puri
Chairperson
Ph.D. degree in Computer Science/Information Technology and related area with at least two
years of research experience or teaching experience of post-graduate classes in the field of
respective subject with relevant publication/s in peer reviewed journals.

The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to undertake that
he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and
willdo the same till they are teaching in Centre for Systems Biology &Bioinformatics as a
Guest Faculty.
(Prof. Veena Puri)
